name: formstep
description: Collect information from people: create a request or share link, send reminders, and read the answers back under stable field keys.

interface.longDescription:
Use Formstep when you need information from someone: their details, a document, a signature or a decision.

Describe what you need and the assistant builds the form, or use one you already have. It then creates a request for one named recipient, with their own link, answers you already know filled in, and locked fields they shouldn't change. For forms anyone may answer, it can create a public share link instead.

The recipient opens the link and needs no account. Their answers save as they go, and the form appears under your logo and colors, in their language. Formstep can email the link and send reminders until they finish.

Ask the assistant at any time who has answered, send a reminder, cancel a request or read the submissions. Answers come back under field keys that stay the same, so a later step can rely on them.

You sign in with your Formstep account and choose one workspace. The connection can reach only that workspace, and you can revoke it at any time from Connected apps & API Keys. The assistant asks before sending or deleting where your client's settings require it.

A Formstep account is required.
capabilities: Create a request for one named recipient
defaultPrompt: Which of my requests are still waiting for an answer?
Create a request for the Client onboarding form and give me the link.
Build a supplier form with company name, VAT number and an insurance certificate upload.

positive.prompt: Which forms do I have in Formstep?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's forms, including Client onboarding and Project feedback.

positive.description: Create a request without sending email
positive.prompt: Create a request for the Client onboarding form for sam@example.com. Prefill their company name as Example AS and don't email it, just give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one request with the company name prefilled, sends no email, and returns the recipient's link.

positive.prompt: Which requests are still waiting for an answer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists pending requests with their recipient and status.

positive.prompt: Show me the latest answers to the Project feedback form.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes recent submissions from that form only.

positive.prompt: Create a draft form called Supplier details with company name, VAT number and an insurance certificate upload. Don't publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft with those three questions and returns a preview link. It does not publish the form.

negative.description: Unrelated request: calls no Formstep tool.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Oslo today?

negative.description: Another form product, with Formstep not selected: calls no Formstep tool.
negative.prompt: Make me a Google Form for event sign-ups.

negative.description: Moving money: calls no tool that charges anyone, and explains Formstep can only add a payment question the recipient completes on a form.
negative.prompt: Charge sam@example.com 500 euros on their card right now.

review.commerce_description: Formstep does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. A form owner can add a payment question to their own form. The recipient pays on the hosted form through the owner's own Stripe account, and the assistant cannot start or complete a payment.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create requests and public share links, build forms, send reminders, and read answers from ChatGPT.
